fit_signal: Jabil publicly describes AXI/AOI inspection for proactive defect capture; current quality roles also perform visual inspection and nonconformance documentation.
pilot_wedge: Evidence-bound reference-vs-inspection review for surfaces or change-detection steps that sit beside existing AOI/AXI, with human disposition retained.

fit_signal: Flex publicly discusses high-speed cameras, AI-assisted visual inspection, anomaly detection, and automated/visual inspection in advanced manufacturing.
pilot_wedge: A bounded evidence-receipt layer for change review, engineering trials, or low-volume/high-mix surfaces where a deterministic audit trail matters.

fit_signal: Sanmina publishes machine-vision verification, optical inspection, and real-time test/inspection traceability as manufacturing capabilities.
pilot_wedge: Receipt-bound supplemental inspection evidence for a selected high-mix process, without replacing 42Q or existing pass/fail authority.

fit_signal: Plexus explicitly offers visual and structural inspection plus automated vision systems to verify placement and polarity, with traceability.
pilot_wedge: Human-review change evidence for a narrowly selected inspection gap or NPI flow, complementing existing automated inspection and traceability.

fit_signal: Celestica publicly describes product reliability testing, inspection, qualification, and failure/yield analysis across complex assemblies.
pilot_wedge: Deterministic before/after visual evidence for NPI, failure analysis, or controlled inspection trials where reviewer provenance matters.

fit_signal: Benchmark says most manufacturing inspection is automated optical inspection and separately describes machine vision for discrepancy detection and continuous quality improvement.
pilot_wedge: A source-first evidence and review layer for experimental or low-volume inspection scenarios that should not directly mutate product disposition.

fit_signal: Fabrinet lists visual inspection, AOI, X-ray, incoming inspection, and in-house inspection labs for complex optical/electronic manufacturing.
pilot_wedge: Evidence-bound visual change review around precision optical/electromechanical assemblies, explicitly supplemental to existing AOI/X-ray.

fit_signal: Polaris Government & Defense describes recorded quality inspections, visual work instructions, 3D scanning, and AI detection systems on its manufacturing line.
pilot_wedge: A bounded review-only pilot for visual-change evidence on one station or component family, preserving Polaris's existing quality authority.

fit_signal: TTM publicly lists automated optical inspection and X-ray inspection across PCB/backplane/system-integration manufacturing.
pilot_wedge: Supplemental deterministic evidence for high-mix visual comparisons or engineering-change verification, not a replacement for AOI acceptance.

fit_signal: Creation Technologies publishes AOI, inspection, validation, verification, and production test-development capabilities for complex systems.
pilot_wedge: Review-only evidence receipts for a controlled NPI/validation visual comparison where deterministic replay and source custody reduce buyer uncertainty.
